title: Muse Spark
before: Meta had anchored the open-weight ecosystem since LLaMA in 2023.
problem: Open releases gave away capability while the returns accrued to competitors and forks.
breakthrough: A closed multimodal reasoning model from a reorganised research group, with no open weights.
why: The largest Western backer of open weights changed sides, leaving the open frontier largely to Chinese labs and OpenAI's gpt-oss.
next: An open ecosystem centred on DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and Zhipu.
inherits: An open frontier with a very different geography from 2023.
